candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s), causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order /v1/orders to fail with ReadTimeout and 502, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory DependencyUnavailable timeouts across all correlated requests.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs not directly observed; timeout inferred from inventory client spans. Root cause of redis slowness (load, saturation) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with ~2s durations. Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (DependencyUnavailable) propagating to inventory 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway 502. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis path. Gateway readyz healthy, so gateway itself is not the fault.
